hook: Water (水) + produce (産): things the water produces, like fish and seaweed.
Cook rice (炊) + task (事): the job of cooking meals.
Water (水) + steam (蒸) + air (気): water that has turned into steam.
Water (水) + element (素): the basic element in water, hydrogen.
Hang down (垂) + straight (直): a line that hangs straight down, vertical.
Guess (推) + decide (定): you guess, then decide on a number, an estimate.
Water (水) + drip (滴): one little drip of water.
Water (水) + tube (筒): a tube you carry water in, a water bottle.
Follow (随) + brush (筆): let your brush follow your thoughts, and you write an essay.
Water (水) + part (分): the water part of something, its moisture.
Sounds like 'zoo zoo': walking into the zoo without a ticket, so shameless!
End (末) + child (子): the child at the end of the line, the youngest.
Tree (木) on the left: 杉 is a tall tree, the Japanese cedar.
Like (好き) + like (好き): each person likes different things, it's a matter of taste.
See-through (透) + pass (通る): light passes right through it, so it is transparent.
Drawing (図) + shape (形): a shape you draw, like a triangle or circle.
Cool (涼): on a hot day you sit in the shade to cool off.
Head (頭) + brain (脳): what is inside your head, your brains.
Drawing (図) + table (表): drawings and tables, so charts and graphs.
Sounds like 'zoo-ray': a sly ray slips out of the zoo, so cunning!
Tax (税) + barrier (関): the barrier where you pay tax on goods, customs.
Manufacture (製) + make (作): making things in a factory.
Control (制) + make (作): creating a work like a film or book under your control.
Clean (清) + write (書): write it again, clean and neat.
Blue/young (青) + few (少) + year (年): people with few years, the youth.
Whole/neat (整) + number (数): neat, whole numbers with no fractions.
Live (生) + exist (存): to stay alive and keep existing, survival.
Politics (政) + party (党): a party in politics.
Make up (成) + part (分): the parts that make up something, its ingredients.
Correct (正) + side (方) + shape (形): a shape with all sides correct and equal, a square.
Main/correct (正) + gate (門): the main gate.
Become (成) + stand (立): something becomes able to stand, it is formed.
West (西) + calendar (暦): the Western calendar, years in A.D.
Back (背) + carry (負う): to carry something on your back.
Red (赤) + road (道): the hot red line around the middle of the Earth, the equator.
Break (折) + horn (角): you broke a horn trying so hard, so don't waste the effort.
Touch (接) + continue (続): parts touch and continue on, a connection.
Seto (瀬戸, a pottery town) + thing (物): pottery from Seto, so china and crockery.
Press (迫): the walls draw near and press in on you.
Stage (台) + words (詞): the words an actor says on stage, their lines.
Tree (木) + all (全): a wooden piece that closes the whole bottle, a stopper.
All (全) + collect (集): all of a writer's works collected together.
Fan (扇) + small thing (子): a small hand fan that folds.
Only (専) + control (制): only one person controls everything, a despot.
Before (先) + before (々) + month (月): the month before last month.
Before (先) + before (々) + week (週): the week before last week.
Before (先) + grandparent (祖): the family that came before your grandparents, ancestors.
Front (先) + end (端): the very front end, the tip.
Front (先) + head (頭): the head at the very front, the leader of the line.
All (全) + general (般): all of it in general, the whole.
Fan (扇) + wind (風) + machine (機): a fan machine that makes wind.
Wash (洗) + face (面): to wash your face.
All (全) + power (力): using all your power.
Each other (相) + differ (違): two things differ from each other.
Increase (増) + decrease (減): going up and going down.
Each other (相) + mutual (互): both sides do it to each other.
Bury (葬) + ceremony (式): the ceremony for burying someone, a funeral.
Build (造) + ship (船): building ships.
Noise (騒) repeated (々): noise, noise, noise, so very noisy.
Increase (増) + big (大): it increases and gets big.
Grass (草) + footwear (履): sandals made from woven grass.
Overall (総) + manage (理) + big (大) + minister (臣): the big minister who manages everything, the Prime Minister.
Continue (続) repeated (々): they keep coming, one after another.
Fast (速) + reach (達): mail that reaches you fast, express delivery.
Measure (測) + amount (量): measuring amounts and land, surveying.
Fast (速) + power (力): how much fast power something has, its speed.
Basic (素) + quality (質): the basic quality you are born with, talent.
Grandparent (祖) + before (先): the grandparents who came before, ancestors.
Sudden (卒) + straight (直): you say it suddenly and straight, so frank.
That (その) + other (他): other than that, besides.
Sounds like 'soar': your razor soars over your chin as you shave.
Escape (逸): the ball escapes the path and goes astray.
Calculate (算) + board (盤): a board for calculating, the abacus.
Exist (存): something exists in my mind, so (humbly) I know it.
Exist (存): like 存じる, something exists in my mind, so I humbly know it.
Loss (損) + gain (得): loss and gain.
Big (大) + craft (工): a big craftsman who builds houses, a carpenter.
Body (体) + lineage (系): a whole body of ideas linked in order, a system.
Body (体) + system (制): the body and rules of a group, its structure.
Body (体) + pile up (積): how much a body can pile up inside, its volume.
Big (大) + layer (層): a big pile of layers, so very much.
Big (大) + tree (木): a big tree.
Replace (代) + name (名) + word (詞): a word that replaces a name, a pronoun.
Oval (楕) + circle (円): a circle stretched into an oval, an ellipse.
Plough (耒) on the left of 耕: you plough the field.
Water (氵) + dragon (竜): water roaring down like a dragon, a waterfall.
Grass (艹) on top of 蓄: farmers store grass and food for winter.
Sounds like 'tada, she...': ta-da, it's free, but there is one condition.
Remove (脱) + line (線): the train comes off the line, derailment.
Calm (妥) + right (当): a calm, right answer, so it is appropriate.
Example (例): you give an example to compare one thing to another.
Rely (頼): someone you can rely on is reliable.
Step (段) + floor (階): steps and floors, so stages.
Short (短) + period (期): a short period of time.
Coal (炭) + mine (鉱): a mine for coal.
Short (短) + place (所): the place where you fall short, a weak point.
Light/pale (淡) + water (水): light water with no salt, fresh water.
Cut off (断) + water (水): the water is cut off.
Single (単) + number (数): a single number, singular.
Short (短) + edit/compile (編): a short piece of writing or film.
Rice field (田): 田んぼ is the wet rice field.
Words (言) at the bottom of 誓: you give your words as a promise, a vow.
Ground (地) + under (下) + water (水): water under the ground.
Near (近) repeated (々): it is near, near in time, so soon.
Near (近) + attach (付ける): you attach it near, bring it close.
Near (近) + come close (寄る): to come close and get near.
Power (力) + strong (強い): strong with power.
Earth (地) + quality (質): the quality of the earth, its rocks and soil.
Land (地) + belt (帯): a belt of land, a zone.
Thread (糸) on the left of 縮: wool thread in hot water shrinks.
Shrink (縮) with める: you make it shrink, shorten it.
Shrink (縮) with れる: hair shrinks up into curls and waves.
Ground (地) + point (点): a point on the ground or map.
Place (地) + name (名): the name of a place.
Arrive (着) repeated (々): arriving step by step, steadily.
Middle (中) + space (間): the space in the middle.
Middle (中) + ten days (旬): the middle ten days of a month.
Pull out (抽) + image (象): pull out the idea from the picture, abstract.
Middle (中) + age/era (世): the middle era of history, the Middle Ages.
Middle (中) + nature/sex (性): in the middle, neither one nor the other, neutral.
Middle (中) + route (途): in the middle of the route, half-way.
Middle (中) + year/age (年): the middle years of life, middle-aged.
Go beyond (超) + pass (過): it passes beyond the limit, an excess.
Carve (彫) + engrave (刻): carving and engraving, sculpture.
Eldest (長) + woman (女): the eldest daughter.
Adjust (調) + joint/moderate (節): adjust it to a moderate level.
Long (長) + short (短): long and short, good points and bad points.
Top of head (頂) + point (点): the top point, the summit.
Eldest (長) + man (男): the eldest son.
Long (長) + side (方) + shape (形): a shape with long sides, a rectangle.
Adjust (調) + taste (味) + material (料): stuff you add to adjust taste, seasoning.
Straight (直) + line (線): a straight line.
Direct (直) + go through (通): goes straight through with no change, direct.
Direct (直) + flow (流): electricity that flows one direct way, direct current.
Save (貯) + storehouse (蔵): saving things in a storehouse.
Straight (直) + angle (角): the straight, square corner, a right angle.
Straight (直) + path/diameter (径): the straight path across a circle.
Scatter (散): things are scattered all over, a mess.
Dust (塵) + paper (紙): paper for wiping dust and dirt, tissue.
Chase/follow (追) + add (加): add more after, an addition.
Go through (通): like 通じる, a road goes through and leads somewhere.
Go through (通) + notebook (帳): the notebook that goes through every bank visit.
Go through (通) + road (路): a road you go through, a passage.
Thrust (突き) + hit (当たり): where you push forward and hit the wall, the end of a street.
Thrust (突き) + hit (当たる): push forward and hit something.
Thrust (突っ) + pack in (込む): push and pack it in, plunge into.
Duty (務): you serve in a role and do its duty.
Effort (努): you make an effort, you try hard.
Crush (潰): the box is crushed flat, or the shop is crushed by debt.
Foot (足) on the left of 躓: your foot hits a stone and you trip.
Color (色) on the right of 艶: a rich color that shines, gloss.
Strong (強) + spirit (気): a strong spirit, firm and confident.
Hang/fish (釣り) + match (合う): two sides hanging in balance, they match.
Hang (吊): to hang something up.
Hang (吊): like 吊る, to hang something down.
Fixed (定) + member (員): a fixed number of members, the capacity.
Low (低) + down (下): going down lower, a decline.
Fixed (定) + period (期) + ticket (券): a ticket for a fixed period, a commuter pass.
Fixed (定) + rest (休) + day (日): the fixed day the shop rests.
Exit (出) + enter (入) + mouth (口): the opening where you go out and in.
Same as 出入口: out (出) + in (入り) + opening (口), a doorway.
Can do (出来) + go up (上がり): it is done and up, finished.
Can do (出来) + go up (上がる): the work is complete and ready.
Target (的) + sure (確): sure to hit the target, so accurate.
Suitable (適) + sure (確): surely suitable, so precise.
Bump out (凸) + dent in (凹): the kanji look like bumps and dents, uneven.
Hand (手) + about (頃): about the right size for your hand, handy and reasonable.
Hand (手) + about (ごろ): just right for your hand, handy and reasonable.
Iron (鉄) + bridge (橋): a bridge made of iron.
Iron (鉄) + cannon (砲): a small iron cannon, a gun.
Hand (手) + wipe (拭い): a cloth to wipe your hands.
Go out (出) + welcome (迎え): going out to welcome someone.
Go out (出) + welcome (迎える): to go out and greet someone.
Sun (日) and fire (灬) are both in 照: they shine.
Pass on (伝) + record (記): a record that passes on someone's life story.
Pass on (伝) + dye (染): a sickness passes on and dyes everyone, contagion.
Electric (電) + pillar (柱): a pillar for electric wires.
Dot (点) repeated (々): dot, dot, dot, here and there.
Roll/turn (転) repeated (々): rolling from place to place.
Heaven (天) + emperor (皇): the emperor from heaven, the Emperor of Japan.
Electric (電) + flow (流): the flow of electricity.
Electric (電) + power (力): electric power.
Unite (統) + one (一): unite them into one.
Same (同) + rank (格): the same rank.
Mountain (山) + up (上) + down (下): the place where the path stops going up and starts down.
Unite (統) + measure (計): gathering and measuring numbers, statistics.
Move (動) + make (作): the moves you make, actions.
East (東) + west (西): east and west.
Throw (投) + writing (書): throw your writing in to a newspaper, a reader's letter.
Steal (盗) + trouble (難): the trouble of being stolen from, theft.
Hit/assigned (当) + number/turn (番): it's your assigned turn, on duty.
Equal (等) + divide (分): divide into equal parts.
Lamp (灯) + oil (油): oil for lamps, kerosene.
Child (童) + story (話): a story for children, a fairy tale.
Pass (通り) + happen on (掛かる): you happen to pass by.
Water (氵) in 溶: water makes sugar melt and dissolve.
Small (小) on top of big (大): small at the top, big at the bottom, a sharp point.
Special (特) + different (殊): special and different, unique.
Special (特) + color (色): its special color, a feature.
Melt (溶け) + go into (込む): melt into it and become part of it.
